scope: current-byte revalidation of pagination authority and NFF logical fence

findings.evidence: Current GithubClaimLease still reads only comments?per_page=100; the WireMock ClaimPaginationRaceCourt was re-run against current bytes and passed, reproducing two competing claimers both returning Acquired.
The same unpaginated 100-comment read remains in heartbeat, stale removal, index repair, and the marker reader used by fetchTask.

BestEffortPush remains void and logs PushOutcome.describe failures without throwing; post-persist revocation still relies on tracker.fetchTask, so NFF protects the remote ref but is not by itself a logical single-holder fence.
fetchTask still derives markers through GithubAbortFactsReader, whose comments read is truncated at 100; both pre-write re-verification and post-persist revocation checks call tracker.fetchTask.

notes: 2cb47c2 changed GithubClaimLease interrupt cleanup behavior but did not add pagination to listComments.
